FirstStep.Title: Congrats!
FirstStep.Text: Congrats! You have taken the first step in your journey! You logged in! Welcome {FirstName}! Today is a new day and you got this! We are 100% on your side and if you follow the suggestions we will give you through this website, you WILL get your kids back faster and then we promise to help you THRIVE post reunification as well.

SecondStep.Title: Congrats!
SecondStep.Text:
Every journey begins with a single step. Imagine yourself on this journey with us. You will have help and encouragement along the way. There will be mountains to climb, rivers to cross and obstacles that might slow you down but you CAN do it! 

Be the hero for your children and be the one responsible for bringing them home!

ThirdStep.Title: Let's do this
ThirdStep.Text: So are you READY? Let’s do this!!!!

StepA.Title: Achieve your DEPARTURE BADGE!!
StepA.Text:
Fantastic, just a couple of questions to get us started… 

Do you or have you in the last several days, use any mind altering substances to cope with your emotions or situations currently in your life?

StepA-1.Title: Find a detox center

StepA-2.Title: Step A
StepA-2.Text: Has it been noted in your case plan that there are suspicions of drug use and have you been asked to do a drug screen?

StepA-2-1.Title: Step A
StepA-2-1.Text: Did you pass or fail the test?

StepA-2-2.Title: Step A
StepA-2-2.Text: What allegations have been made that resulted in your kids going into care?

StepA-2-3.Title: Step A
StepA-2-3.Text: No Problem! Life is sometimes crazy busy and near overwhelming isn’t it? Your Peer mentor will work with your case manager to get you to a drug screening. Check back here once you know the result

StepA-3.Title: Step A
StepA-3.Text:
A little bird told us you have been to Detox! What a HUGE step!  We are all routing for you.  Your kids are routing for you!  You’ve GOT this! 

 You've earned 15 points and are on your way to crossing that huge river in front of you called Rehab River

StepB.Title: Step B
StepB.Text:
You’ve settled on a Rehab – you’re amazing!  We hope you know that.  Terrific, fantastic, awesome, amazing!  Keep going girl – you can do it.  We are all behind you.  Don’t forget! High five between bird and animation.  Make sure you talk to your Peer Mentor if you need anything at all.  Moms Adopting Moms has you covered. 

Remember, rehab river is very long and very difficult for most to cross but we will be with you every step.

StepC.Title: Step C
StepC.Text: Now that you’ve gotten to rehab and settled in, we can talk about finding you a job and do other things to help navigate your way across rehab river!

StepC-2.Title: Step C
StepC-2.Text: Thanks for letting us know what we need to address together. While some would consider those as massive rivers you need to cross and others on that list might just be obstacles you need to overcome, we are with you to help tackle them. But first steps first...

StepD.Title: Step D
StepD.Text: Can you let us know if you are working currently?

StepD-1.Title: Step D
StepD-1.comments: TO-DO pretty sure what i did above was wrong but need to figure out how to implement multiple inputs

StepD-2.Title: Step D
StepD-2.Text: Before we can find something that would be a great fit, we need to make sure you have all the proper identification that employers are looking for…

StepE.Title: Step E
StepE.Text: You applied for all your ids – TERRIFIC!! You are on your way to finding the perfect job. AND you just earned 10 points!  You are one step closer to earning your APPRENTICE badge!

StepE-1.Title: Step E
StepE-1.comment: You're meant to send the dream job input to the peer mentor in email

StepE-2.Title: Step E
StepE-2.Text: Which of these types of jobs have you done before that you enjoyed?

StepE-3.Title: Step E
StepE-3.Text:
Here are five jobs that fit with what you enjoy and your experience hiring right now in your area. Fill out the application and let’s see what happens! We’re also including a few job search tools that you can use to search as well. We’re routing for you!! 
{SearchForJob}
StepE-3.Comments: There are meant to be two paths here, Step F is for users who were or in rehab, step G is for users who are not in rehab but I didn't know how to show a distinciton in the user journey

StepF.Title: Step F
StepF.Text:
Studies show that recovery is more certain the more committed you are to attending self help meetings during your time in rehab and beyond,  In fact only 26^%of people are able to stay sober if they don’t attend compared to 82% if they do. 

Do you need help finding local self help meetings in your area?

StepF-2.Title: Step F
StepF-2.Text: Great!– your rehab has probably hooked you up with all the meetings you need, have you been attending regularly?

StepF-2-1.Title: Step F
StepF-2-1.Text: Wooo hooo great job.  You’re killing this.  It works if you work it!  You just earned 10 points

StepF-2-2.Title: Step F
StepF-2-2.Text:
We can get you connected to all the meetings in your area.  Sign up now and keep moving down your path. You are doing great! 
{SearchForMeetings}

StepG.Title: Step G
StepG.Text: Which of these Assessments did DFCS require from you in your case plan?
StepG.comment: Implement checklist and drop down menu code

StepH.Title: Step H
StepH.Text:
Have you been attending each week? 

Let your peer mentor know ASAP if you have not been able to see your kids or need any help with your visits.  These are SOOOOO important!  Your kids think you are terrific and they love you so much!  And by regularly attending your visitations you have earned your  APPRENTICE BADGE!!!

StepI.Title: Step I
StepI.Text:
Ever need someone to just talk to?  Someone that can understand where you’re coming from and help you sort it all out?  Someone that has been there and can offer great advice?

Yes, we are talking about counselors and they are not just for Bio moms with kids in care, they are for EVERYONE!
StepI.comment: Implement drop down menu code For Each Selected, show the top 3 results in their zip code for licensed counselors specializing in that add fireworks too

StepJ.Title: Step J
StepJ.Text: Have we told you lately that we think you’re amazing??  Look how far you’ve come!! You are already 1/3 of the way through to not just reconciling with your kids but THRIVING well past reunification!  Well done you.  You’ve just earned another 15 points and you are on your way to earning your NOVICE badge!! Keep going!  We are all routing for you!

StepK.Title: Step K
StepK.Text: It’s really important that you end up in your career choice and while you are going through rehab and before your kiddos come home is the perfect time to really think about what you want to do and let us help you find the resources, classes, trainings you need to get there.
StepK.comment: Implement Dropdown menu, job and trainings

StepL.Title: Step L
StepL.Text: We also found these FREE online resources for your chosen profession that you can do in your own time, at your own pace!  For every one you complete you get 5 points!

StepM.Title: Step M
StepM.Text: We also found these FREE online resources for your chosen profession that you can do in your own time, at your own pace!  For every one you complete you get 5 points!

StepN.Title: Step N
StepN.Text: AWESOME job!! Did you know you have already gotten _______ Insert the number of points and you are only a few steps away from earning your NOVICE Badge!  Well done you!Now let’s research parenting classes.  Sometimes these are setup at your visitation center and sometimes you need to find one in your area so just in case, here are suggestions for upcoming parenting classes nearby:

StepO.Title: Step O
StepO.Text: So are you an expert now in all things Parenting?? Parenting is HARD work but you got this. You can do it and even though NONE of us are perfect parents I bet you learned a few things you can apply when your kids come back to you.  Not long now!  You are nearly halfway there and only a few steps away from getting your kids back!  Well Done!! We are SOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO Proud of you!

StepP.Title: Step P
StepP.Text: So how is your transportation situation?  Need some help finding a new ride that can fit you AND your kids comfortably?

StepP-1.Title: Step P-1
StepP-1.Text: How do you get around now?

StepP-2.Title: Step P-2
StepP-2.Text: Excellent!  You are one step closer to your kiddos coming home!

StepQ.Title: Step Q
StepQ.Text: You did it!!! You are now a Novice!!  You have earned your next badge.  This is huge!!  Look at how far you’ve come!! We are SOOOOOOOOOOOOO proud of you!  15 points for earning your NOVICE BADGE!! You are on your way to becoming a Journeyman now!  This is where you will find a house for you and your kids, get it furnished and all setup and get your kids back!

StepR.Title: Step R
StepR.Text: $$$ BUDGETING, SAVINGS and INVESTMENTS $$$ In order to live a stress free life, not only do you need to get adequate training in the career field of choice and be making a decent salary but you need to know where you are spending your money and how to save and invest for your future!  Here are some budgeting classes you can take nearby to help you learn what you need to know.  You will receive 10 points for completing a budgeting class!

StepS.Title: Step S
StepS.Text: Houses, Apartments, Mobile Homes, Duplexes – there are so many choices but you are going to need some help!NPlease enter the city and state or zip code of where you would like to live and we will show you what’s available in that area to rent.

StepT.Title: Step T
StepT.Text: YEAH!!! You’ve found a place to live!  CONGRATULATIONS!  Now let’s get it furnished!

StepU.Title: Step U
StepU.Text: Light Turns on and Off and pipe runs with water. Please enter your NEW address so we can tell you who to contact to get your electricity and water turned on!
